lead: Soothe, cool and hydrate — wherever you need it. A premium recovery cream that massages into tired muscles, joints and skin, blending aloe, shea butter and nourishing oils with a cooling essential-oil and menthol blend. Silky, fast-absorbing comfort.
note: 4 oz (113 g) · use up to 4× daily · ships in 1–2 days

science.title: Cool, soothe, hydrate
science.text: After a hard session, tired muscles and dry skin both need care. This cream works on the surface: a cooling menthol and essential-oil blend gives that soothing post-workout sensation, while aloe, shea butter and a blend of coconut, olive, sesame and rosehip oils deeply hydrate and nourish. Silky, not greasy — it absorbs fast and leaves skin comfortable.

format.title: A spa moment for tired muscles
format.text: More than a moisturiser — a recovery ritual. Massage it into muscles, joints and tendons for a cooling, calming sensation, and into dry skin anywhere it needs hydration.
list: — Massage a small amount in, up to 4× a day

ingredients.title: Skin-loving botanicals
ingredients.lead: Aloe and shea for hydration, oils for nourishment, menthol to cool.*

items.name: Aloe Vera
items.text: A soothing, water-rich aloe base that calms and hydrates the skin.

items.name: Shea Butter
items.text: Organic shea butter — rich in fatty acids to deeply moisturise and soften skin.

items.name: Plant Oil Blend
items.text: A blend of coconut, olive, sesame and rosehip oils to nourish, replenish and protect.

items.name: Cooling Menthol
items.text: Menthol and an essential-oil blend for that fresh, cooling, post-workout sensation.

facts.note: * Organic ingredient. For external use only.
facts.other: Full ingredients (INCI): Water (Aqua), Aloe Barbadensis Leaf Juice, Cocos Nucifera (Coconut) Oil, Stearic Acid, Butyrospermum Parkii (Shea) Butter*, Olea Europaea (Olive) Fruit Oil (OliveM 1000), Cetyl Alcohol, Leuconostoc/Radish Root Ferment Filtrate, Sesamum Indicum (Sesame) Seed Oil*, Lactobacillus Ferment, Cocos Nucifera (Coconut) Fruit Extract, Rosa Canina (Rosehip) Fruit Oil, Citric Acid, Tocopherol, Menthol. *Organic.
facts.side_text: A premium cosmetic cream with aloe, organic shea butter, coconut, olive, sesame and rosehip oils, naturally preserved with radish-root ferment and tocopherol (vitamin E). Net 4 oz (113 g). Made in the USA.
facts.warning: For external use only. Not for use on open wounds or broken skin. Avoid contact with eyes — if contact occurs, rinse thoroughly with clean water. If irritation occurs, discontinue use. Wash hands after applying. Keep out of reach of children. Store in a cool, dark place.

usage.title: Massage in, up to 4× a day

steps.title: Take a small amount
steps.text: Scoop a small amount onto your fingertips — a little goes a long way.

steps.title: Massage into the area
steps.text: Massage gently into muscles, joints, tendons or dry skin until absorbed.

steps.title: Up to 4× daily
steps.text: Reapply as needed, up to four times a day. Wash your hands after use, and avoid broken skin.

series.title: Silky, not slick
series.text: The light, OliveM-emulsified texture absorbs quickly without a greasy residue.

items.a: It's a topical recovery and hydration cream — massage it into tired muscles, joints and tendons for a cooling, soothing feel, or into dry skin anywhere for deep hydration.

items.q: Is it a supplement you eat?
items.a: No — despite the label wording, it's a topical cosmetic cream for external use only. Apply it to your skin; don't ingest it.
Menthol and an essential-oil blend give that fresh, cooling sensation, which is why it's popular after workouts on muscles and joints.
No — it's emulsified to absorb quickly and feel silky rather than oily, so it sinks in without leaving residue.

items.q: Where and how often can I use it?
items.a: Massage a small amount into muscles, joints, tendons or dry skin up to four times a day. Avoid broken skin and the eye area, and wash your hands after.
